nodes.name: default.json
nodes.summary: Default capture configuration template with no camera intrinsics set, specifying image extraction settings (300 images, 20 marked, ArUco marker length/id) used as a fallback when generating training data from real-world video captures for GSplat reconstruction.

nodes.name: iphone15pro.json
nodes.summary: Capture device configuration for an iPhone 15 Pro, providing OpenCV camera intrinsics (focal lengths, principal point, distortion coefficients) at 1920x1080 resolution plus the same image-extraction settings as the default profile, used when processing device-recorded video into GSplat training data.

nodes.name: pixel8pro.json
nodes.summary: Capture device configuration for a Google Pixel 8 Pro, providing OpenCV camera intrinsics (focal lengths, principal point, distortion coefficients) at 1920x1080 resolution plus the same image-extraction settings as the default profile, used when processing device-recorded video into GSplat training data.
